title: Clarify that initial Git task push uses a code branch without a task tree
outcome: Clarify that initial Git task push uses a code branch without a task tree
acceptance: Specification initial1000-task push and Git task-sync brief consistently say the configured ordinary code branch has no task tree, rather than requiring an empty remote branch or a separate data branch.
disposal_reason: Superseded. Its criterion asks the docs to say there is no separate data branch, but Greg chose a separate orphan data branch for task sync (rules-greg-sync-data-off-code-branch-2026-11-08), implemented by w-4eabb205c7b2, whose criterion 4 rewrites the task-sync docs. Closed by Engram::Fable after a read-only triage, under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08 and Greg's #803.
